cases.case_label: 121-bp AluYb9 at edge of SPAST intron 16
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5'-truncated 121-bp AluYb9 with 30-bp poly(A) and 15-bp TSDs at the edge of SPAST intron 16 segregated in a four-generation AD family and altered SPAST splicing, shown by blood RNA-seq and RT-PCR.
cases.quote: We identified an intronic AluYb9 insertion inducing splicing alteration in SPAST causing pure HSP phenotype that was not detected by routine WES analysis.
